messages.text:
Hello,

 I saw the advertisement for the milkweed seed packets for $1.99. 

 We are 15-20 minutes South of Boston, I believe it’s zone 6. 

 We already have the beautiful orange butterfly milkweed that I absolutely love. 

 But until I saw this add I thought that was the only variety. 

 I was interested in picking up some of all the other varieties through Lasclay but I wanted to run it by you to see if that makes sense. 

 I’m changing the layout of my yard and it’ll give me a 200’ x 5’ stretch of border that runs N to S, gets lots and lots of sun, with some areas getting a little tree supplied shade depending on the hour. 

 Long text I know, but I’d love to saturate that whole area with the different colors and look of these milkweed. 

 What do you think?

 Thank You,

 Dennis Manning
